// diagnostic

E2805

Invalid HTTP route `{pattern}`: {reason}.

What

Invalid HTTP route `{pattern}`: {reason}.

Why

Route patterns use one canonical grammar. Ambiguous escapes, traversal, duplicate names, or retired markers would make routing and audit metadata disagree.

Fix

use `:name` for one segment or final `*name` for a catch-all. Percent-encode a literal leading `:` or `*`; never encode `/`.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E2805: tests/ui/http_route_invalid_literal.stderr.

Error [E2805]: invalid HTTP route `/users/{id}`: brace interpolation is not allowed in route patterns; it is indistinguishable from the retired `{name}` parameter spelling

    |
  9 |     router.get("/users/{id}", handle)
    |                ^^^^^^^^^^^^^
 Why: route patterns use one canonical grammar; ambiguous escapes, traversal, duplicate names, and retired markers would make routing and audit metadata disagree
 Fix: use `:name` for one segment or final `*name` for a catch-all; percent-encode a literal leading `:` or `*`, and never encode `/`
